title: Photo Apparatus
description: Adds camera that allows you to take a picture and save it on a map
body:
Simple mod that adds a "Photo Apparatus"

![Recipe of a camera, 6 copper ingots at the bottom as if you were making a trapdoor, then spyglass on the top row at the center, slots on the right and the left to spyglass are empty](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1027064985b2047ca66f4ccbeda198b4136f9764.png)

Once equipped, you'll see camera GUI that has viewfinder box and zoom bar.

![Example of player's GUI showing viewfinder and zoom bar](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eb2fbb1159f069f6c66771db8a2e91997bafe8c5_0.webp)

Viewfinder box shows what part of your screen will be "screenshoted".
Zoom bar shows your current zoom level, which you can change either slowly (using CTRL + scrolling up/down) or instantly to minimum/maximum zoom (CTRL + Shift + scroll).

Now (in survival) you need to have vanilla empty map in your inventory, since, well, this camera uses it like a film.

If you done selecting the best angle and zoom, just press right mouse button to take a picture

![Example of how map looks in player hands after taking a picture](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3bab3dfec1460b1428c0667fe474fbd2a6d2a367_0.webp)
